name: 73601 · Clinton, OK
findings: ZIP 73601 (Clinton) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73601 (Clinton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
